label: Document history retention
type: the byte-quota setting controlling how much document-change history a bucket or collection aims to retain on disk, restricted to Couchbase buckets/collections on the Magma storage backend. Distinct from server:collection-change-history (the boolean flag stating whether retention is active at all).
evidence: Specifies how many bytes of document history the bucket should aim to retain on disk. This option is valid for Couchbase buckets with Magma storage backend only.
Specifies whether or not the document history retention should be enabled for the collection.
note: Settable at both bucket level (bucket-create/-edit, a byte quota) and collection level (collection-manage, a boolean toggle) - a tier split of the kind this project's filing convention normally resolves under one tier-neutral id; kept as one record covering both tiers.
relates_to_competency_question: Is document history retention configured the same way at bucket level as at collection level?
